baseline.source: canon: WFB 8e Dwarfs army book; WH: The Old World (2023+) Dwarfs background (King and Thanes, guilds of Engineers/Runesmiths/Miners, ancestor cult, Book of Grudges)
baseline.why: A hold is a hereditary kingdom of clan Thanes with guild masters, standing regiments, guild-controlled trade and industry, insular borders and gunpowder-plus-steam engineering

AZL.note: Iron Hills hold; baseline unchanged (source silent on its institutions).

ruling_igs.source: canon: Josh Reynolds, Neferata (Black Library, 2013; Neferata takes the dwarf hold Silver Pinnacle as her seat, per the publisher blurb); canon: WFB Vampire Counts (the Lahmian Sisterhood; from memory, page not checked); TW:WH3 (Neferata and the Lahmian Sisterhood at the Silver Pinnacle, per third-party guides)
